clues.text: At the king's gate in Susa, he would not bow down or pay homage to Haman.
In Susa, he brought up his orphaned cousin Hadassah and took her as his own daughter.
Sitting at the king's gate, he learned two eunuchs were plotting to kill King Xerxes and reported it.
Haman had a gallows fifty cubits high built to hang him, but Haman was hanged on it instead.
Haman was ordered to dress him in a royal robe and parade him on the king's horse through Susa.
He warned Queen Esther that perhaps she had come to the kingdom for such a time as this.
King Xerxes gave him the royal signet ring that had been taken back from Haman.
